reusable_cues.rationale: Stops an in-build reimplementation of something another component owns; generalises as the anti-reinvention move.

source_text: So, your "ledger of open items" is effectively what Elephant-2000 is supposed to maintain, so let's not reinvent that *inside* our build.  C-c ; says it isn't defined for me, although I have separately loaded xiaoxiang-preview.el

fragments.text: So, your "ledger of open items" is effectively what Elephant-2000 is supposed to maintain, so let's not reinvent that *inside* our build.
fragments.target: the agent's proposed ledger-of-open-items: rerouted to Elephant-2000, not rebuilt in this project
fragments.rationale: The operator recognises the agent's new proposal as an existing commitment's territory — Elephant-2000 is supposed to maintain exactly this ledger — and vetoes the in-build reimplementation. Recognition precedes the veto: the agent's idea is mapped onto its pre-existing owner, then stopped. The happened_summary shows the agent agreeing and dropping the ledger ('marks should feed Elephant-2000's records, not a new store').

display_cues.text: what Elephant-2000 is supposed to maintain

pattern_refs.rationale: One owner per fact: the ledger of open items already has an authority (Elephant-2000); a second copy inside this build would be a competing authority, so Joe refuses it at proposal time rather than at drift time.
The deliberate reuse decision: make neither a new store nor a parallel ledger — use Elephant-2000, the existing make.

fragments.rationale: A failure report with the obvious suspect eliminated: the operator did load the file ('although I have separately loaded…'), so the bug is not a missing load. The elimination is what let the agent find the real cause quickly (the buffer running on an older copy of the mode map, fixed in 1ee5fea7). Same move as the earlier proposal operator/report-the-symptom-with-one-suspect-eliminated (turn-VmzYXj) — its first recurrence.
